result.summary: Rework 01c of docs/design/M2AUTH-accounts-tenancy-backup.md by the gate 1b findings B1-B7, N1-N6, the grants-gate note H1 and the Addition of decisions/0137. Blocking ones: grants.sql in one to_regclass-guarded do block per table (static grants, no execute) with MG-6 and MG-7; a deadline guard before every statement and before COMMIT so a late transaction rolls back (COMMIT limit 900 ms, worst case 4.9 s, in-doubt residual named) with ADD-2; row locks (select … for update) first in login, re-auth and password change, a new pg file auth-race-pg.test.js; one connection and one transaction per request, a tenant route switched by switchToTenant (set_config) with TXH-5 and DBC-3; PW-2b kills M2 and M42 becomes with check (true); e-mails printable ASCII only so the column check equals the validator; B7a/N2c a login_failures table keyed by mac(e-mail) gives unknown, disabled and deleted e-mails the wrong-password answer and the same lock; B7b AUTH_CODES 23 with body_too_large and site_closed (TX-11, RT-6); B7c TOTP missing/wrong counts for the admin delay (LO-7). Low ones: count by a constant count statement (N1), scrypt N=2^17 with maxmem 160 MiB and a bundled SecLists list (N2a, N2b), ASVS rows rewritten (N2), TRUNCATE trigger (N3), admin 404 before any statement without a session cookie (N4), the runbook creates the roles first on another server (N5), late refusals not counted named (N6). 32 of 32 criteria mapped; 61 mutants; two new questions О15 (REQ-114 text still says 2^15) and О16.

issues.text: REQ-114 description («crypto.scrypt N = 2^15») and criterion 1 (form `scrypt$15$8$1$<salt>$<hash>`) contradict decisions/0137 Addition N2a (N = 2^17). The design uses 2^17 and `scrypt$17$8$1$`, so PW-1 as criterion 1 is written would be red. Recommended: a micro-amendment of REQ-114 (the two places, the form of decisions/0079 item 5) by REQ-ANALYST and REQ-VALIDATOR before step 2.

The common-password check (0137 Addition N2b) stands as test-named cases PW-4, SU-5 and RS-2 under REQ-114 c1, not as a criterion of its own. Recommended: confirm, so RELEASE-VALIDATOR reads them under c1.

B2 residual named in design 4.5.2: a COMMIT already sent whose answer is lost or later than 900 ms leaves the outcome unknown to that request (503); the window is the COMMIT round trip only. Every other late transaction is rolled back before COMMIT (F24).

Proposed anti-patterns for DOC-UPDATER (Q13), beyond the two of step 01: a deadline race that answers 503 while the transaction later commits (F24); a transaction opened inside another on one PGlite never answers (F25); a lockout read and written around a slow hash without a row lock loses counts under parallel attempts (B3).
